A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 17-page Switch-a-View paper, including supplementary Sections 7.1–7.11. Full text and rendered-page comparisons establish that only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp differs.

before.justification: v2 reports original view-switch detection and view-selection experiments on HowTo100M and Ego-Exo4D, including baseline comparisons, ablations, and supplementary analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original experimental results in Tables 1–9 and Figures 3–5, including the supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: The pseudo-labeler, multimodal view-switch detector, adaptation for view selection, and training objectives are identical, including the joint-finetuning variant in Section 7.4.

E1.justification: Both retain HowTo100M view-switch detection, Ego-Exo4D zero-shot detection and limited-label view selection, and Charades-Ego training for the pseudo-labeler's view classifier. No dataset, task, or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain identical baseline membership: heuristics, InternVideo2 and CLIP retrieval, view-narration similarity, and LangView variants. Tables 1–2 and 8–9 are unchanged.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, annotation filtering, training settings, teacher-forcing evaluation, and accuracy/AUC/AP calculations are identical. Both retain 8-second frame context, 32-second narration context, a 2-second prediction interval, and 5,000 view-selection training samples.

E4.justification: Both contain the same input and pretraining ablations, pseudo-labeling analysis, agreement-threshold and context-duration studies, sample-count analysis, scenario breakdown, and qualitative cases in Sections 5 and 7.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including annotator-agreement statistics and p ≤ 0.05 statements in table captions. No run-count, seed, interval, or statistical-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results, and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 1 retains 63.8% HowTo100M AUC for Switch-a-View, and Table 2 retains 56.0% AP for Ego-Exo4D view selection.

T1.justification: The task definitions and mathematical formulations, including Equations 1–8, are identical. No assumptions, derivations, propositions, or proofs are added, removed, or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about learning view preferences from unlabeled human-edited videos and transferring them to view selection with limited labels.

C2.justification: Results interpretations and limitations are identical, including discussion of complementary inputs, missing next narrations, incorrect past-view labels, equally suitable candidate views, and future continuous or personalized view selection.

D1.justification: Implementation, data-processing, and annotation details in Sections 5 and 7.9–7.11 are unchanged. Embedded link targets also match, including the project and supplementary-video access information.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and all 64 numbered reference entries are identical.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv v2 dated 14 Mar 2025 to v3 dated 22 Apr 2025. All other wording, headings, terminology, and document structure remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–7, Tables 1–9, equations, captions, and page layout are visually identical. The stamp's textual update does not change the layout.

improvement.justification: The main paper and appendices retain identical scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and visual presentation. The sole version/date stamp update does not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
